snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | Deep Dive Into The World - Bloober Team Dev Diaries
snippet.description:
Learn more about the post-apocalyptic world of our upcoming sci-fi survival horror game - Cronos: The New Dawn in our first Dev Diary. 

Listen to game directors Jacek Zięba and Wojciech Piejko as they share their insights about the game’s protagonist and its worldbuilding. To spice things up, we’ve even had our devs answer community questions and share never-before-seen snippets of gameplay!
Wishlist Cronos: The New Dawn!

Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/

Epic Games Store: store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409
Follow Cronos on official channels:
X: x.com/CronosNewDawn 
www: cronosnewdawn.com/

Music:
“Particle Wave” – composer: Garret Weyenberg
“Tomorrow's War” – composers: Enrico Cacace/John H. Nixon
“Cold War” – composers: Harel Tsemah/Itamar Carmel/Itay Steinberg/Or Kribos
Published by: Universal Music Publishing
